title: Properties of the final Noetherian base system
statement:
In the system of
[def-nagata-final-noetherian-base-system], every $S_\lambda$ is
Noetherian and of finite type over $\mathbf Z$, every transition map is
affine, and $\kappa_S$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text:
Here $S$ is the quasi-compact quasi-separated base of the section, so
[prop-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system] applies to the explicitly selected
system $\mathsf N(S)$ of [def-nagata-final-noetherian-base-system]: every
$S_\lambda$ is of finite type over $\mathbf Z$, every transition map is
affine, and $\kappa_S$ identifies $S$ with $\varprojlim_\lambda S_\lambda$,
that is, $\kappa_S$ is an isomorphism. Each $S_\lambda$ is Noetherian by
[def-nagata-noetherian-inverse-system].
